reason: Gated by tests/payroll-run-orderings.test.ts, the 'leave and overtime recorded after the early settlement' and 'an off-cycle bonus after the next period's late lines' cases at a low, middle and high wage: each late line is paid once; an EARNED scheme's two months and year to date equal the combined path to the cent, a later run of the paid month billing the late lines and their top-up as the earned month's (`payslips.adjustments.earned_period`, `payslips.statutory.earned_*`); a PAID scheme's late statutory equals bill(next month incl. the late lines) − bill(next month without them). Those titles are templated per lineage, so no golden is named. Unset is PAID, a lawful cash-basis default. PIT: income is taxed when paid, PAID. SI, HI, UI, UNION_DUES, UNION_FEE: priced on the contract's monthly salary, with no rule moving a late payment into its earned month. Owner-delegated rule (2026-10-01): where the law is silent on the month a late line belongs to, PAID.
